title: START production (re-run): first supervised Claude run on Arcadia (Claude only, 1 Action, draft PR only, never merges; approves its own build packet for 24h)
problem: RE-RUN: the first one-shot already activated; this restarts the run after a services restart for the tmux launch fix, and refuses unless that fix is on main and the pointer is still on the Action. ONE PRESS TURNS PRODUCTION ON FOR ARCADIA'S OWN REPOSITORY ON THE CLAUDE PROVIDER. For the single Action implement-a-hermetic-test-that-an of the Plan arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider, the production worker may approve the build packet it prepared (delegation, Decision 0072, expiring 24 hours after the press), launch one Claude Code Session (claude-code-cli), and preserve its work to a pushed branch and a DRAFT pull request. It never readies, reviews or merges a pull request and never pushes a base branch: a supervising agent reviews and merges the PR. The policy itself has no expiry: it ends when the Action finishes or when you press the STOP button (restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11). Spend is bounded by Decision 0130: the capacity gate must be ON, so before each launch the worker reads Claude usage read-only and admits work only while both the 5-hour and 7-day windows are at or below 80%; plus the 1-Action scope, one Session at a time, the 120-minute Session limit, 3 attempts per Action and STOP. Press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 FIRST: this Grant refuses while the workspace config still says codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled: false. Production must be Inactive when you press it and the installed release must match main. If you do not want this, do not press.
desired_effect: After fail-closed preconditions (launched from the actions library; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset; main clean, level with origin and with a fresh ls-remote; Decision 0130 approved with an answer; the Plan active; the installed release ready and runtime-identical to main; the capacity gate ON in the workspace config and in the capacity read; claude-code-cli signed in from the worker's sources; the capacity read admitting claude-code-cli or stale only; production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id unused), compute the delegation expiry as 24 hours from now, derive the expected scope fingerprint from the pinned scope and that expiry, preview at the current policy revision requiring that exact fingerprint with the one Action queued and ready, preview again immediately before activation requiring the identical fingerprint and revision, activate once with that expected revision and request id grant-production-first-supervised-claude-run-r2-20261017 and Decision 0130, then verify the activated fingerprint equals the preview and turn this Grant Off on any mismatch: Project arcadia, Plan arcadia/arcadia-runs-production-unattended-on-its-own-repository-on-the-claude-provider, exactly its 1 Action arcadia/implement-a-hermetic-test-that-an, provider claude-code-cli, concurrency one, transitions validation, acceptance, pointer and packet_approval with a 24-hour packet-approval expiry, --remote-preservation, no integration grant, no rehearsal exception, no Session limits beyond the defaults.

does: Runs only when launched through the operator-action library (its exact id and descriptor are required in the launch environment), not inside a Codex sandbox and not with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, with its script and descriptor tracked and unmodified at the main checkout's HEAD. No agent should launch it: the press is yours
Requires PROJECT.md current_action to equal the one Action and src/sessions/tmuxLauncher.ts to exist at main's HEAD (the tmux launch fix), so a re-run never launches with the known-bad launch path

Requires main clean, level with last-fetched origin/main and with a fresh 30-second ls-remote, Decision 0130 approved with a recorded answer, the Plan active, and an installed broker release that is ready and runtime-identical to main

Requires the capacity gate ON: the martianrover workspace config must not set codingAgent.capacityGateEnabled: false, and the capacity read must not report claude-code-cli as unmetered by configuration (press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 first)

Requires the worker-context Claude Code sign-in to read signed in (only the verdict is recorded, never the token) and the capacity read to admit claude-code-cli or report it only stale (the worker refreshes the usage reading read-only before each admission, Decision 0130); an exhausted window, the 80% reserve margin or unknown usage refuses before anything changes
Requires production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id not already in the policy

Computes the 24-hour packet-approval expiry once, derives the expected scope fingerprint from the pinned scope plus that expiry, requires the preview at the current policy revision to equal it with exactly the 1 Action queued and ready, previews again immediately before activation (within five minutes of the computed expiry) and requires the identical fingerprint and revision, activates once with --expected-revision and its own request id, then verifies the activated fingerprint

Under Decision 0072 lets the worker approve the build packet of the Action inside this exact scope (whose only provider is claude-code-cli), only while the policy is Active and the delegation unexpired; under remote preservation the worker pushes the preserved candidate branch and opens its draft pull request

After any activation attempt that does not verify (including a failed, timed-out or unparsable activate, or SIGTERM/SIGINT), reads production status back (retrying three times), returns only its own Grant to Off if it is Active, and records the observed state in a timestamped receipt and failure handoff. If status stays unreadable it issues an Off blind under a fresh request id (safe because production was Inactive before this run, and an Off only removes authority) and records off_issued_unobserved, or UNKNOWN telling you to press STOP now if that Off is not confirmed
never_does: Never authorizes a GitHub merge, readying a pull request, a reviewer run or a push to any base branch: there is no integration grant and no worker-merge opt-in, so the worker only pushes a branch and opens a draft pull request
Never grants another Project, Plan, Action (anything beyond the 1 named), provider, transition or a concurrency above one, and never lifts the concurrency gate

Never edits the workspace config or changes the capacity gate, credentials, branch protection, repository settings or any Decision, Plan or Action; never refreshes the Claude usage reading itself, so it never exchanges or rotates your Claude sign-in
Never launches, terminates or resumes a Session, restarts a service, or reactivates production after Off
Never activates twice under its request id: the one-shot button stays disabled after success
Never turns a failed or unverified activation into a success: it returns its own Grant to Off (a blind Off only when status stays unreadable) and says so

success.effect: One scoped policy is Active under request id grant-production-first-supervised-claude-run-r2-20261017 whose recorded fingerprint equals both previews and the fingerprint derived from the pinned scope; the receipt names the Action, the packet-approval expiry, the capacity gate state, the Claude sign-in verdict, the installed release and main.
success.next: Watch production status and the dashboard: the tick prepares and approves the packet, refreshes the Claude usage reading read-only and launches one Claude Code Session if both windows are at or below 80%; the draft PR needs a supervising review and merge. To stop at any time press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11.

failure.effect: If no activation was attempted, policy is unchanged. After an attempt, the script reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off when it is Active, and records the observed result (not_active, returned_off, other_grant_active, OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN). When status stays unreadable it issues an Off blind and records off_issued_unobserved (whether this Grant was Active is then unknown, and the receipt says activated unknown).
failure.next: Do not press again blindly. Read the handoff; if it says OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN, press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11 now. Otherwise resolve the named drift (press enable-capacity-gate-20261017 if the gate is off, STOP if a previous grant is still Active, reinstall the broker if the release is stale, sign Claude Code in if the verdict is not signed_in) and ask for a fresh Grant if an activation was attempted or the Action is no longer ready; a refusal before any activation attempt can be pressed again once the drift is fixed.
